summary: The exact candidate is a substantive partial fix: after a pinned native rebuild it diagnoses the reported make_layout, composition, layout/tile divisibility, complement, and inverse regressions, preserves the legal dynamic-profile controls, and passes the existing LayoutAlgebra suite. It does not complete the approved structural validation contract. A logical_divide whose TileType contains a statically non-congruent LayoutAttr still reaches layout algebra internals and aborts in intTupleFilterZero instead of producing an operation diagnostic.
remaining_counterexamples: fly.logical_divide with layout !fly.layout<128:1> and divisor !fly.tile<[((4,8),2):(1,(4,32))]> aborts with exit 134 at IntTupleUtils.h intTupleFilterZero because TileType divisor validation computes only its static product and does not validate the embedded LayoutAttr shape/stride structure.

tests.what_was_measured: Pinned-LLVM native rebuild and prepared vector-add GPU numerical smoke before reproducing the issue; native-build record saved as /job/review-evidence/base-native-build.json.

Original structural-validation failure reproduced on the prepared base: invalid composition reaches a native assertion rather than a diagnostic. Raw stdout, stderr, and exit status are under /job/review-evidence/base-regression.*.
Pinned-LLVM candidate native rebuild plus real FlyDSL vector_add 100x1000 numerical smoke on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950; record saved as /job/review-evidence/candidate-native-build.json.
The candidate's regression checks the supplied static counterexamples and legal dynamic-profile controls with the rebuilt candidate compiler.

tests.command: Execute every RUN line in tests/mlir/LayoutAlgebra/*.mlir with rebuilt fly-opt and pinned LLVM FileCheck
tests.what_was_measured: All RUN lines in all 11 layout-algebra test files passed; raw log is /job/review-evidence/layout-suite.log.

Independent structural adversarial case for logical_divide: a TileType containing a malformed LayoutAttr is accepted by the verifier and aborts in intTupleFilterZero. Raw stdout, stderr, input, and exit status are under /job/review-evidence/adversarial-malformed-tile.*.

Python source resolved to /job/repo/python/flydsl and native extension hashes were recorded from /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d3f1e84ace39/native-build/python_packages/flydsl/_mlir/_mlir_libs; evidence is /job/review-evidence/import-paths.txt and candidate-native-sha256.txt.

gpu_evidence: Both prepared rebuild invocations passed the supplied FlyDSL vector_add 100x1000 numerical smoke on one AMD Instinct MI355X, architecture gfx950. The verifier behavior itself is architecture-independent and was measured directly with rebuilt fly-opt.
remaining_limitations: Dynamic SSA extents expose only static profiles to these verifiers. Value-dependent divisibility, bounds, and invertibility remain runtime concerns unless runtime checks are added.

The authenticated GitHub token could not query the public ROCm organization because that organization rejects tokens with this lifetime; review used the supplied upstream issue snapshot, the accessible mirror PR metadata, and the exact local commits.

The rebuild helper records source_revision as the prepared base even for a detached candidate rebuild; exact candidate identity was independently confirmed with git rev-parse, and the distinct rebuilt working-tree hash and native artifact hashes were retained.
No architecture limitation blocked this review. GPU smoke coverage was limited to the assigned gfx950 device and does not establish behavior on other GPU architectures.
